exposure: Patients with TVS signs of bladder DIE and anterior adenomyosis
fibrotic thickening of the bladder wall
outcome: postsurgical sonographic findings of the pelvis
cohort: The study included 40 women who underwent laparoscopic partial cystectomy for bladder endometriosis.
finding: Post-operative transvaginal sonography (TVS) can detect pelvic alterations and could explain the persistence of symptoms like dysmenorrhea and dysuria in women treated for bladder endometriosis.
